key_insight: Armillary qLDPC codes encode more than one logical qubit per two data qubits while supporting fixed-connectivity superconducting hardware.
engineering_relevance: High encoding rates and crossing-free routing layers offer a path to lower-overhead fault-tolerant superconducting processors.
method: Generate code structure from native iSWAP routing under hardware constraints.
Jointly enforce stabilizer commutation and correct parallel syndrome extraction.
Use radial and circumferential couplings across 5–6 hardware tiers.
evidence_signal: Circuit-level simulations of the [[8688,4348,16]] code yield a logical error rate of 1.62×10⁻¹² per logical qubit per round at 0.1% physical error; constructed codes have distances of 12–16.
watch_item: Results are simulation-based; realizing 5–6 hardware tiers and weight-12 stabilizer measurements remains an implementation challenge.
paper_title: Rate-1/2 Quantum LDPC Codes for Multi-tier Superconducting Hardware
